_note: Q3 2026 earnings call summaries for /reits and /reits/[ticker]. Hand-written from the company results releases (8-K Ex. 99.1), 10-Qs and call transcripts; every item cites its sources by key. No industry-panel (paid) data.

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 4, 2026

headline.text: Q3 comparable RevPAR up 8.8%; 2026 RevPAR growth estimate raised to about 6.75%.

items.label: Results
items.text: Comparable hotel RevPAR was $219.50, up 8.8%, and comparable Total RevPAR was $348.19, up 7.3%.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: Host raised its 2026 comparable hotel RevPAR growth estimate to about 6.75% and Total RevPAR growth to about 6.0%, and Adjusted EBITDAre to about $1,865 million, a $35 million increase.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: After the quarter, Host bought the leasehold interest in the 195-room 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge for $202 million and the 308-room Renaissance Dallas at Plano Legacy West for $172 million. It also amended and extended its $2.5 billion credit facility.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: Phoenix comparable RevPAR fell 32.0% to $110.47 as occupancy dropped to 40.1% from 61.9%, while average rate rose to $275.17 from $262.62. The 10-Q attributes the Phoenix decline to renovation disruption at The Westin Kierland Resort & Spa, which is under renovation as part of Host's second Marriott Transformational Capital Program.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: Management said 2027 total group revenue pace is 6% ahead of the same time last year.

quote.text: Looking ahead, our 2027 total group revenue pace is also 6% ahead of the same time last year, driven by rate, room nights, and strong banquets contribution.
quote.speaker: Sourav Ghosh, EVP and CFO

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 5, 2026

headline.text: Q3 Comparable Hotels RevPAR up 7.3%; 2026 RevPAR growth guidance raised to 5.1%–6.1%.

items.label: Results
items.text: Comparable Hotels RevPAR was approximately $134, up 7.3%, with ADR of approximately $171, up 4.3%.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: Apple raised 2026 Comparable Hotels RevPAR growth guidance to 5.1%–6.1%, up 235 basis points at the midpoint, and Adjusted EBITDAre guidance to $482–$493 million.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: Apple did not repurchase shares in the quarter, and about $242.5 million remained on its authorization. Management said five hotels are under contract for sale for a combined gross price of about $72 million.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: Management tied the raise to year-to-date results and October performance; preliminary October Comparable Hotels RevPAR was up approximately 10%.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: Management said it expects to be meaningfully more acquisitive than it has been recently.

quote.text: it would be reasonable to assume, and I think expected based on the opportunity set that we're looking at today, that we would be meaningfully more acquisitive than we have been recently.
quote.speaker: Justin Knight, CEO

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 4, 2026

sale.label: 8-K on the Four Seasons Resort Scottsdale sale, filed Nov 3, 2026

headline.text: Q3 comparable RevPAR up 14.4%; results release only, no call held.

items.label: Results
items.text: Comparable RevPAR was $284, up 14.4%, on ADR of $419, up 8.6%, and occupancy of 67.9%.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: The Q3 release gives no updated 2026 guidance, and Braemar held no conference call for the quarter.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: Braemar closed the sale of Four Seasons Resort Scottsdale on Oct 28, 2026 for $372 million, which it puts at a 5.8% capitalization rate on trailing-12-month NOI including $23 million of anticipated capital expenditures. The quarter's net loss to common shareholders of $240.9 million mainly reflects a $480.0 million advisor termination fee.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: The company describes the Scottsdale sale as the final sale needed to complete its transition to self-management and pay the remaining fees owed to its external advisor.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: The company says it remains on track to become a self-managed REIT in mid-November.

quote.text: Comparable RevPAR surged 14.4%—our strongest growth since the post-pandemic recovery in 2022 and another near-record result for the quarter—and comparable Hotel EBITDA increased 20.7%
quote.speaker: Richard J. Stockton, President and CEO, in the results release

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 5, 2026

headline.text: Q3 RevPAR up more than 8% to $161; 2026 RevPAR growth guidance raised to 4.0%–4.5%.

items.label: Results
items.text: RevPAR for the 39 comparable hotels rose more than 8% to $161, an all-time third-quarter high for the company. RevPAR at its four Silicon Valley hotels rose 23% to $174.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: Chatham raised 2026 RevPAR growth guidance to 4.0%–4.5%, with Adjusted EBITDA of $104.2–$105.3 million and AFFO per share of $1.38–$1.40.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: Chatham repurchased no shares in the quarter. Total debt was $408 million at a 5.9% average rate.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: Management credited corporate travel in Silicon Valley, saying the market has come back after years of investor questions about when it would.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: October RevPAR rose 8% to $170, an all-time October high, and management expects fourth-quarter RevPAR growth of approximately 3.5%–4%.

quote.text: Of course, for us, for years, we were asked by investors and potential investors when Silicon Valley was going to come back to life, and we can affirmatively say it is.
quote.speaker: Jeff Fisher, Chairman, President and CEO

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 3, 2026

headline.text: Q3 comparable RevPAR up 6.6%; 2026 RevPAR growth guidance raised to 4.75%–5.25%.

items.label: Results
items.text: Comparable RevPAR was $226.01, up 6.6%, on ADR of $290.46, up 3.8%, and occupancy of 77.8%.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: DiamondRock raised 2026 comparable RevPAR growth guidance to 4.75%–5.25% from 2.5%–4.0%, and Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $322–$327 million from $310–$320 million.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: DiamondRock bought The Bellmoor Inn & Spa (79 rooms, Rehoboth Beach) for $31.0 million on Oct 1, 2026. Year to date through Sept 30 it repurchased about 0.2 million shares for $1.9 million, and $299.4 million remains on its $300 million program.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: The release attributes the raise to stronger-than-expected third-quarter results and improved fourth-quarter booking pace. On the call, management said about 70% of the RevPAR outperformance came from transient and 30% from short-term group pickup.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: Management said group pace for the next four quarters is approximately in line with the prior year, with the first quarter of 2027 the largest opportunity for additional pickup.

quote.text: While overall pace for the next four quarters is approximately in line with the prior year, the first quarter of 2027 represents our largest opportunity for additional pickup.
quote.speaker: Briony Quinn, EVP, CFO and Treasurer

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 3, 2026

headline.text: Q3 pro forma RevPAR up 7.2%; 2026 RevPAR growth guidance raised to 3.50%–4.50%.

items.label: Results
items.text: Pro forma RevPAR was $126.17, up 7.2%, on ADR of $167.95, up 5.3%, and occupancy of 75.1%.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: Summit raised 2026 pro forma RevPAR growth guidance to 3.50%–4.50%, up 150 basis points at the midpoint, and Adjusted EBITDAre guidance to $181–$186 million from $175–$182 million.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: Summit sold the Courtyard and Residence Inn Dallas (Arlington South) for $19.0 million in July. Management said three hotels are held for sale.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: Management estimated the World Cup added 80 to 90 basis points to third-quarter RevPAR, and said September RevPAR grew more than 11%.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: Preliminary October RevPAR grew approximately 5.5%, and fourth-quarter pace is up approximately 5% over last year.

quote.text: Operating trends have continued to trend positively into the fourth quarter, as preliminary October RevPAR growth finished at approximately 5.5% in our pro forma portfolio, and fourth quarter pace is up approximately 5% over last year.
quote.speaker: Jon Stanner, President and CEO

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Oct 29, 2026

headline.text: Q3 Same-Property RevPAR up 8.3%; 2026 RevPAR growth outlook raised to 7.6%–8.0%.

items.label: Results
items.text: Same-Property RevPAR rose 8.3% to $256.66, on ADR of $318.52, up 7.0%, and occupancy of 80.6%. San Francisco RevPAR rose 14.5%.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: Pebblebrook raised its 2026 Same-Property RevPAR growth outlook to 7.6%–8.0%, up 280 basis points at the midpoint, and Adjusted EBITDAre to $363.3–$367.3 million.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: Pebblebrook sold The Hotel Zags in Portland for $10.0 million on Oct 8 and recorded a $77.3 million non-cash impairment in the quarter tied to that sale and its review of other possible sales. It repurchased 1.2 million common shares for $20.9 million in the quarter.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: Management said one-time events added only about 40 basis points to the quarter's RevPAR growth.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: Management said total group and transient revenue pace for 2027 is ahead by almost 5%.

quote.text: Our portfolio-wide total group and transient revenue pace is currently ahead by almost 5% versus this year.
quote.speaker: Jon Bortz, Chairman and CEO

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 4, 2026

headline.text: Q3 comparable RevPAR up 8.4%; 2026 RevPAR growth guidance raised to 5.5%–6.0%.

items.label: Results
items.text: Comparable RevPAR rose 8.4% to $201.02, on ADR of $263.19, up 5.0%, and occupancy of 76.4%.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: Park raised 2026 comparable RevPAR growth guidance to 5.5%–6.0% from 3.0%–4.5%, and Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $635–$645 million from $617–$637 million.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: Park sold Hilton Short Hills in July for $12 million and The Wade, a 520-room hotel in Chicago, in October for about $19 million. In September it repaid the $1.275 billion CMBS loan on Hilton Hawaiian Village.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: Management said RevPAR growth accelerated from 9% in July to more than 13% in September despite weather disruptions in Hawaii in August and September.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: Park expects fourth-quarter comparable RevPAR growth of 5.5%–7.5%.

quote.text: RevPAR increased 8.4% year-over-year, with growth accelerating from 9% in July to more than 13% in September, despite weather-related disruptions in Hawaii during August and September.
quote.speaker: Tom Baltimore, Chairman and CEO

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 3, 2026 (release dated Nov 2, 2026)

headline.text: Q3 same-store RevPAR up 7.9%; 2026 RevPAR growth guidance raised to 4.5%–5.5%.

items.label: Results
items.text: Same-store RevPAR rose 7.9% to $187.49 and Total RevPAR rose 8.0% to $477.82. Gaylord Opryland RevPAR rose 15.5%.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: Ryman raised 2026 same-store RevPAR and Total RevPAR growth guidance to 4.5%–5.5% each, from 3.5%–4.5%, and AFFO per share guidance to $9.16–$9.43.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: Capital expenditure guidance was narrowed to $450–$500 million. Management described the period after the Grande Lakes Orlando acquisition as a digestion phase, and there were no sales.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: The release cuts Entertainment segment guidance by $3 million, which management tied to the retirement of the General Jackson Showboat.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: Same-store group rooms revenue on the books for 2027 was 4.5% ahead of the same time last year at the end of September.

quote.text: As of the end of September, same-store group rooms revenue on the books for 2027 was 4.5% higher than the same time last year for 2026, 130 basis point improvement since the end of July.
quote.speaker: Mark Fioravanti, President and CEO

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 4, 2026

headline.text: Q3 comparable RevPAR up 9.7%; 2026 RevPAR growth guidance raised to 5.75%–6.25%.

items.label: Results
items.text: Comparable RevPAR rose 9.7% to $153.36, on ADR of $203.35, up 6.4%, and occupancy of 75.4%.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: RLJ raised 2026 comparable RevPAR growth guidance to 5.75%–6.25%, up 200 basis points at the midpoint, and Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $352–$358 million.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: In October RLJ sold seven hotels near Chicago Midway Airport for $110.0 million, which it puts at 13.8x forecasted 2026 Hotel EBITDA, or 16.1x including required capital expenditures, and provided $20.0 million of seller financing.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: Management tied the raise to third-quarter outperformance, strong October results and an expectation that positive trends carry into the rest of the year.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: The comparable outlook excludes the seven Midway hotels and assumes no further acquisitions, dispositions or share repurchases.

quote.text: we are raising our full-year guidance to reflect our third-quarter outperformance, the strong operating results seen in October, and our expectations that positive trends should carry into the remainder of the year.
quote.speaker: Leslie Hale, President and CEO

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 6, 2026

headline.text: Q3 RevPAR up 11.4%; 2026 RevPAR growth guidance raised to 9.5%–10.5%.

items.label: Results
items.text: RevPAR rose 11.4% to $235.22, or 10.3% excluding Andaz Miami Beach, and Total RevPAR rose 10.5% to $394.97.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: Sunstone raised 2026 RevPAR growth guidance to 9.5%–10.5% from 7.0%–9.0%, and Adjusted EBITDAre guidance to $254–$259 million.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: From the start of 2026 through Nov 5, Sunstone put $196.9 million into repurchases of its common and preferred stock, with $310.6 million of authorization remaining.

items.label: Why, per the company
items.text: Excluding Andaz Miami Beach, hotel margin rose 50 basis points to 26.7%; the company says it would have risen about 200 basis points excluding the Hilton Key West renovation and one-time items.

items.label: Outlook
items.text: Management said group pace for 2027 at its Wailea resort on Maui is up over 20%.

quote.text: This trend accelerated through the third quarter, with group pace for 2027 now up over 20%.
quote.speaker: Bryan Giglia, CEO, on Wailea

release.label: Q3 2026 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1), filed Nov 3, 2026

headline.text: Q3 Same-Property RevPAR up 12.5%; 2026 RevPAR growth guidance raised to 7.75%–8.25%.

items.label: Results
items.text: Same-Property RevPAR rose 12.5% to $184.75, on ADR of $264.00, up 6.4%, and occupancy of 70.0%.

items.label: Guidance
items.text: Xenia raised 2026 Same-Property RevPAR growth guidance to 7.75%–8.25%, up 250 basis points at the midpoint, and Adjusted EBITDAre guidance to $278–$284 million.

items.label: Deals and capital
items.text: Xenia sold Kimpton RiverPlace in Portland in July for $11 million. It repurchased no shares in the quarter, and $97.5 million of authorization remains.

items.label: Why, per the company

items.label: Outlook
items.text: Management said 2027 group room revenue pace was down about 4% from the same time last year.

quote.text: Group room revenue pace for 2027 was down approximately 4% compared to the same time last year.
quote.speaker: Atish Shah, EVP and CFO
